polityNote: Ghana since independence 1957-03-06. Atoms: the 260 district assemblies of 2019 (Ghana Statistical Service polygons via geoBoundaries GHA ADM2, 2019). Every region of 1957–2019 is a union of whole 2019 districts: each later region was carved from exactly one parent (C.A. 11 and PNDCL 41 define a region as the area of named local councils), and no inter-regional transfer of territory after 1957 is recorded in statoids, Wikipedia or Bening (2012) — the only regional changes are the splits in events. ① Area of each union against the published region area: Ashanti 24484/24390 km² = 1.004; Brong-Ahafo 40271/39557 km² = 1.018; Central 9706/9826 km² = 0.988; Eastern 19046/19977 km² = 0.953; Greater Accra 3715/2593 km² = 1.433; Northern 70075/70383 km² = 0.996; Upper East 8658/8842 km² = 0.979; Upper West 19110/18477 km² = 1.034; Volta 20981/20572 km² = 1.020; Western 24439/23921 km² = 1.022; North East 9110/9070 km² = 1.004; Western North 10118/10079 km² = 1.004; Bono East 23356/22248 km² = 1.050; Oti 11113/11066 km² = 1.004. Rewritten from the earlier ne-admin1 dossier (10 NE atoms), whose 11 unresolved entries were the six regions of February 2019 (they follow district lines inside NE atoms) and a supposed 1969–70 Central/Western window that C.A. 11 settles at 1960-07-01.

sources.title: Graphic Online — Akufo-Addo names Techiman capital of Bono East Region
sources.says: Ceremony on Wednesday 13 February 2019 presenting Constitutional Instrument 113, which gives the Bono East Region legal backing.

sources.title: Graphic Online — Sefwi-Wiawso named capital of Western North Region
sources.says: C.I. 117 for the Western North Region presented on 15 February 2019 (the 15th region), with the Oti Region the same afternoon (the 16th).
